status.description: Known states: previewed, executing, committed, failed, unknown. Only committed proves success; future values require review.
status.title: Status

cursor.description: Opaque invalidation cursor; retain exact bytes, not a write receipt.
cursor.title: Cursor

stopped.description: True only when the specified current pending reply was truncated.
stopped.title: Stopped

current_updated_at.description: Current mood-entry CAS token on conflict, or null when the day is absent.
current_updated_at.title: Current Updated At

detail.description: Legacy detail is preserved, including validation error arrays.
detail.title: Detail

status.description: Known states: pending, done, cancelled. Due does not mean a notification was delivered.
status.title: Status

expected_version.description: Optional compare-and-set version; stale edits return 409 without changing memory or history.
expected_version.title: Expected Version

kind.description: Known kinds: fact, inference, question; retain future values.
kind.title: Kind

status.description: Known states: candidate, confirmed; unknown values are not confirmation.
status.title: Status

action_proposal.description: Reviewable proposal only; no action has been performed.
action_proposal.title: Action Proposal

bubbles.description: Currently delivered parts of this reply, in order.
bubbles.title: Bubbles

delivery_next_ms.description: Suggested delay before refreshing pending parts.
delivery_next_ms.title: Delivery Next Ms

delivery_pending.description: Additional reply parts are still scheduled.
delivery_pending.title: Delivery Pending

updated_at.description: Exact ISO UTC CAS token; compare without modifying. Globally increasing across writes and deletion/recreation.
updated_at.title: Updated At

operation_sha256.description: SHA256 of the exact original UTF8 JSON string; null only for not_found.
operation_sha256.title: Operation Sha256

result_updated_at.description: Historical outcome version, not proof of current diary content. Query moods separately.
result_updated_at.title: Result Updated At

info.title: 念响 · 具身个人伙伴 PC MVP

202.description: Same request is running or requires outcome review; never silently re-execute.

post.description: Accept only content already previewed in the user's browser; no filesystem access.
Parse a selected Word file in memory; do not persist or call the model.
Synthesize only a fully delivered assistant message on explicit request.
